parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb unbind-db-resource-group-with-role --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --resource-group-name testgroup --role-list testrole --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb UnbindDBResourceGroupWithRole --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --RoleList testrole --ResourceGroupName testgroup
